verificationChecks.rule: Zero Orphan / Disconnected Nodes across all 1,330 entities
100% Direct-to-Chip Liquid Cold-Plate Inlets and Outlets Connected to Manifolds & Headers
verificationChecks.details: 144 / 144 GPU cold plates fully plumbed. Failed: 0

verificationChecks.details: Q_latent = 58.03 kW <= Q_recovered = 81.56 kW (Surplus buffer = 23.53 kW)

verificationChecks.rule: Independent Dual-Path 2N Distribution: 144 / 144 servers dual-corded with dedicated PSU A and PSU B
288 / 288 Server 200G DAC links connected; Non-blocking 1.0:1.0 oversubscription verified to 800G Spine
verificationChecks.details: 288 / 288 NIC ports connected via 200G DAC to Top-of-Rack switch. Disconnected: 0

verificationChecks.rule: All entities assigned deterministic finite [x, y, z] 3D coordinates within facility bounds
